title: Maintenance Record of the Home in Systems Settlements — Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
Homeowner maintenance items, homeowner damage and homeowner alterations found at inspections lower a systems-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty through its maintenance-record multiplier, applied to the program's cash-in-lieu maximum in the scheduled systems settlement.

**Rule.** The maintenance-record multiplier counts the inspections on the coverage within the last 24 calendar months (dated later than the same calendar day 24 months before the settlement date) that found a homeowner maintenance item, homeowner damage or a homeowner alteration: two or more take 0.80; exactly one takes 0.90; none takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

| Inspections in the window with one of the three findings | Maintenance-record multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1.00 |
| 1 | 0.90 |
| 2 or more | 0.80 |

**Points of reading.**
- Every inspection on the coverage is read, on any claim item, not only the item under settlement.
- Findings such as defect confirmed, within tolerance or not reproduced are not counted.
- Settled on 1 June 2026, the window takes inspections dated 2 June 2024 or later.
